recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Vocabulary decides to add formal computable constraints for these operation parameter combinations or asks for a broader editorial pass over operation examples.
issue_request: FHIR-18655 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It asked whether invalid parameter combinations for CodeSystem operations should have defined error conditions; the resolution said no formal definition was available, but wrong combinations should be made clearer and an example rejecting a bad parameter combination should be added.
initial_application: Jira cites git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. That terminology-ballot commit added CodeSystem operation response examples for $lookup, $subsumes, and $validate-code, including an OperationOutcome response for a missing required system parameter in $validate-code. Later source restructuring moved operation definitions into source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-*.xml while preserving the examples.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes CodeSystem, and source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml references the $lookup, $validate-code, and $subsumes OperationDefinitions. Current descriptions require $lookup to provide system+code or coding, $subsumes to provide A and B code/Coding inputs plus a system unless invoked on an instance, and $validate-code to provide exactly one of code+system, coding, or codeableConcept. Later FHIR-33941 work refined $validate-code output parameters but retained and strengthened the input-combination sentence; FHIR-37449 cleanup preserved the relevant descriptions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already implements the Jira resolution. No source hunk met the threshold for a necessary current-spec correction.
